verdict.rationale: Lorikeet documents that a human agent takes over when the AI can't resolve a conversation and that outbound flows have escalation paths for sensitive situations, showing some handoff capability, but there's no documented configuration for handoff by topic, sentiment, customer tier, or explicit request, nor evidence of reliability testing specifically for escalation triggers. missing for 10: granular handoff-condition configuration (topic/sentiment/tier/explicit request), evidence of reliable enforcement/testing of those specific triggers.
